discovery: A traceable source identifies a potentially relevant organization. Listings, official company material, filings, trials, patents, news and reviewed referrals can nominate it.
sector_eligibility: At least one verified membership supported by dated source references to actual products, technology or business activities. Labels, keywords and social attention alone nominate candidates.
identity_gate: Verified legal entity with a corroborated entity-level identifier or reviewed legal documentation. A ticker/ISIN identifies a listing, not a company. Subsidiaries and receipts remain separate unless supported links establish their roles.
detailed_tracking_gate: Identity and sector gates pass, no unresolved identity/identifier collision or rejection, and an explicit activation record identifies policy version, decision time and reviewer.
financial_threshold_note: No size, revenue, profitability or valuation threshold has been agreed; do not invent one.
private_companies: Eligible without a listing. Missing from an exchange inventory does not prove private ownership.
display_scope: Display-panel manufacturing alone does not establish chip design, manufacturing, packaging, materials or equipment activity under taxonomy 1.0. Review any separately supported semiconductor business independently.
timestamps: Keep earliest supported discovery observation, source publication/effective dates, sector review time and watchlist activation time distinct. Unknown historical dates stay null.
historical_membership: Retrospective collection for today's list is not historical watchlist membership. Do not backdate activation or change the universe hash of an existing window.
legacy_collection: Existing candidate collection can continue for discovery. collection_enabled is not proof of admission; preserve legacy activation time as unknown until supported.
reentry_and_changes: Append admission, suspension and reactivation decisions with reason and provenance; retain prior records and identifiers. No silent merges or retroactive overwrites.
